project.name: GeoLocate
project.finalModel: Sectors + ResNet34 + two-stage training + class weights + distance penalty (0.1)

finalPerformance.note: Lower-performing classes are intentionally omitted here to keep this section focused on the strongest evidence.

experiments.name: CNN + FC
experiments.summary: Initial baseline was heavily underfit for the diversity of scenes.
experiments.tradeoff: Very simple model, very low geographic signal capture.

experiments.name: Sectors + CNN + FC
experiments.summary: Switching to sector labels gave an immediate boost by reducing class sparsity.

experiments.name: Sectors + ResNet18
experiments.summary: Transfer learning made a large jump in classification quality.
experiments.tradeoff: Good baseline, but minority sectors remained unstable.

experiments.name: Sectors + ResNet18 + two-stage training + class weights
experiments.summary: Two-stage fine-tuning and imbalance handling produced a major gain.
experiments.tradeoff: More moving pieces and tuning complexity.

experiments.name: Sectors + ResNet18 + two-stage training + weighted sampler
experiments.summary: Oversampling helped exposure but did not beat class-weighted loss in this run.
experiments.tradeoff: Can increase variance when minority classes are very noisy.

experiments.name: Sectors + ResNet18 + two-stage training + class weights + one cycle LR
experiments.summary: One-cycle scheduling converged well but not to the top score for this backbone.
experiments.tradeoff: Faster training dynamics, slight consistency tradeoff.

experiments.name: Sectors + ResNet34 + two-stage training + class weights
experiments.summary: Moving to ResNet34 gave the strongest classification jump.

experiments.name: Sectors + ResNet34 + two-stage training + class weights + distance penalty (0.1)
experiments.summary: Distance-aware objective improved geographic quality without dropping test accuracy.
experiments.tradeoff: Requires careful weighting to avoid over-penalizing uncertain samples.

experiments.name: Sectors + ResNet34 + two-stage training + class weights + distance penalty (0.2)
experiments.summary: A stronger penalty kept similar top-line performance in this report.
experiments.tradeoff: Can increase optimization sensitivity at higher weights.

experiments.name: Sectors + ResNet50 + two-stage training + class weights + distance penalty (0.1) + one cycle LR
experiments.summary: ResNet50 did not outperform the tuned ResNet34 path in this comparison.
experiments.tradeoff: More parameters, but lower efficiency-to-score ratio here.
